title: Harm is not Universal: Community-Specific Toxicity Detection is Urgently Needed

bias_targets.methodology: Collaborating with experts to develop community-specific safety guidelines for blind/low vision (BLV) and dwarfism (DWF) communities, annotating text-to-image (T2I) generated images, and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and toxicity detectors using zero-shot, in-context learning, visual question answering (VQA), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
